verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration legal-services firm that handles O-1, EB-1 and green-card cases with attorney support. A sandbox test environment isolated from production data is a software/API axis that doesn't fit this kind of product. The evidence shows no API or developer platform (llms.txt and OpenAPI probes all return 404), so nothing makes the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
